workarounds.symptom: [FR] Log a per-scorer error count in mlflow.genai.evaluate() run metrics
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Log a per-scorer error count in `mlflow.genai.evaluate()` run metrics. Target files: mlflow/genai/evaluation/harness.py, mlflow/genai/scorers/aggregation.py, tests/genai/evaluate/test_evaluation.py. `mlflow.genai.evaluate()` now logs `<scorer>/error_count` for each scorer that failed at least once.
